description: This file defines the 'Calls' class within the Step\Acceptance namespace, providing methods to automate the creation of call records in a SuiteCRM testing context, including creating calls and relating them to modules.

classes.name: Calls
classes.description: Provides methods to create and relate call records during acceptance testing.

methods.name: createCall
methods.description: Creates a call record with a specified name, filling in date and description fields.

methods.name: createCallRelateModule
methods.description: Creates a call record and relates it to a specified module and module name, optionally setting additional parameters.
